name: [X20 + SYNC DANCE] EVEN THOUGH IT'S EASY TO MOUNT
desc:
⛰️Welcome to the mount "Even though it's Easy"

Climbing the mountain is fun with friends can sync dance/emote!

This map has obstacles with difficulty Easy - Middle

✨ Use the carry system to pick up friends there is also sync dance/emote

💡 Use various Glowstick Coil Colors to make it cooler

🌌 Enjoy 6 kinds of cool sky

🔥 There are many Cool Aura looks that you can get for free

🎯 And of course, there are 10 checkpoints to get to the top

After the peak you will find 2 portals that go to two different dimensions.

1. Photo spot with the theme of the sea of clouds and Devil statue

2. Photo place with many posters of your idols

Don't forget to Like this map and take documentation to make it into an album, then send it to the discrod that has been listed 👇
